description: Set up the development environment: create the branch from feat/project-scaffold, install dependencies, verify the project imports correctly and passes linting.
steps: Run: git checkout feat/project-scaffold && git checkout -b feat/phase1-pipeline
Run: python -c "import studio; import pipeline; print('OK')" to verify imports
Run: ruff check . && ruff format --check . to verify linting passes
Run: pip install openai pyyaml to add dependencies needed for AI stages (openai for LLM abstraction)
acceptance_criteria: Branch feat/phase1-pipeline exists and is checked out, based on feat/project-scaffold
ruff check . passes with no errors
ruff format --check . passes with no errors
findings: System required yum install of pango-devel cairo-devel python3.12-devel for pycairo/manimpango. Scaffold code had no ruff config; added [tool.ruff] to pyproject.toml with F403/F405 ignored (Manim star imports pattern). Fixed 7 auto-fixable issues and 8 manual issues (E501, B904, B007). ruff format reformatted 5 files. openai and pyyaml installed for AI stages.
